name: ruflo-protector
description: Project Anatole: an optional, learning watchdog for unattended agents. Deterministic OWASP-mapped rules, a per-project behavioural baseline, four modes (off, learn, notify, enforce), alerts you can read later.

mode.title: Project Anatole mode
mode.description: off: do nothing. learn (default): record the baseline and say nothing. notify: alert, never block. enforce: rules marked block deny. A mode set with /protector mode overrides this.

autoGraduate.title: Graduate learn to notify
autoGraduate.description: When the baseline is mature (200 events, 3 sessions, 24 hours), move learn to notify. Never moves to enforce.
